summary: Introduce lists with a full sentence, use bullets for unordered items and numbers for steps, keep bullets parallel, capitalize first words (except simple item lists), and add periods to bullets within body copy.
questions: Should bullet points end with periods?
When should I use a numbered list instead of bullets?
Do bullet items need to be grammatically parallel?

answer_card.title: Writing lists
answer_card.answer_md:
- Introduce every list with a complete sentence.
- Bullets for unordered items; **numbers for steps**.
- Keep bullets parallel (all verb phrases, or all sentences).
- Capitalize the first word, except for plain item lists.
- In body copy, end bullets with periods, even fragments; standalone promo bullets don't need them.
